# Flutter Leaf Common Library - LLM Documentation

This index lists Leaf Common documentation pages formatted for LLMs.
Each link points to a standalone Markdown file under the /llms path.

## Cancelable

- [CancelableFuture](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/cancelable/cancelable.md): Wrapper for cancelling a pending Future callback

## Converter

- [TypeConverter](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/converter/type-converter.md): Safe dynamic-to-typed value converter

## DateTime

- [Date & DateTime](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/datetime/datetime.md): Date manipulation with Jiffy, lunar calendar support, and DateTime extensions

## Exception

- [HTTP Exception](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/exception/exception.md): Base exception class with 16 HTTP/Dio subclasses and helper utilities

## Extension

- [Extensions](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/extension/extensions.md): Utility extensions for Color, String, Number, List, Map, Uri, MediaQuery, FocusNode, GlobalKey, and AssetImage

## Logger

- [Logger](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/logger/logger.md): LeafLogging utilities with platform-aware console output

## Model

- [UIModel](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/model/ui-model.md): Abstract base models with Equatable and payload support (V1 and V2)
- [ResultValue](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/model/result-value.md): Result/error value pattern for API responses with chained error display
